prompts.army:
Use case: illustration-story / ads-marketing.
Create an ORIGINAL polished military slice-of-life comic illustration strip. Exactly TWO equal-size panels side-by-side, thin dark ink border, narrow cream gutter, overall image 2200x1000 pixels, 2.2:1 horizontal aspect ratio.
Clean professional editorial comic drawing: crisp confident black outlines, controlled cel shading, natural adult human anatomy, distinctive attractive faces, expressive brows, believable hands with five fingers, tidy uniforms, calm cream background with restrained colors and strong readability. Contemporary hand-inked comic quality, more refined than simple clip art. Original characters and art direction; no imitation of a named comic, no existing comic characters.
Each panel shows TWO colleagues from the waist up in a simple military-base gym entry area INDOORS; no hats indoors. Their heads begin at 31% of panel height, bodies extend to the bottom. Leave the TOP 27% of EACH panel empty pale cream/white for speech bubbles to be typeset later. No dramatic light effects, no grunge, no excessive details.
No text anywhere, NO speech balloons, NO lettering, NO drawn phones or screens, NO logos, no watermark. Clothing tape patches can be blank branch-appropriate fabric rectangles, correct pockets/collars/cuffs. No weapons, body armor, helmets, costumes or tactical accessories. Everyday neat standard working uniforms, sleeves down. The two same characters recur across the two panels with consistent faces and uniforms.

Branch: U.S. ARMY. Both wear normal Operational Camouflage Pattern Army combat uniforms, irregular multicam-like tan/olive/brown patches (NOT pixel digital camo), coyote tan undershirt. Neat collars and two slanted chest pockets, realistic cloth, dark muted tape details.
Characters: young Black male soldier with neat short fade, and East Asian woman soldier with hair in a neat low bun. Normal fit adult physiques.
Left panel: man at left turns to his colleague at right, holds a modest paper workout plan, eyebrows raised inquisitively; colleague looks back expectantly.
Right panel: same two, man at left shrugs with one open hand and a wry embarrassed smile, colleague at right raises one eyebrow with an amused deadpan expression.
Background: simple warm off-white gym wall with one subtle muted olive rack shape. Palette cream, olive, tan, ink black. Sharp, uncluttered, warm relatable military humor.

marines.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the Marine uniforms in this original two-panel comic strip, preserving absolutely all character identities, faces, poses, anatomy, layout, crop, ink quality, backgrounds, blank top region and two-panel dimensions.
Both people are U.S. MARINES in the standard Marine Corps woodland MARPAT utility uniform, olive undershirts. Correct specific uniform errors in BOTH panels:
1. REMOVE every small square center-chest rank patch/tab between the chest pockets. Marine utility blouses do NOT use the Army-style center rank tab. Restore natural continuous woodland MARPAT fabric in those areas.
2. REMOVE large plain tan hook-and-loop squares or rectangular patches on the upper sleeves. Replace those patch areas with uninterrupted woodland MARPAT camouflage cloth. No Army-style shoulder patch panels.
3. Woodland MARPAT should be more woodland olive-green/dark green and brown with black dense digital pixel flecks and small tan accents, not predominantly orange/tan. Preserve the crisp miniature digital pattern and natural folds.
Chest name/service tape rectangles can remain plain subdued olive fabric with no text. Keep both regular utility chest pockets. No new text or insignia. No center rank patch. Everything else stays unchanged.
